content.name: Elif Şahin
content.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
content.summary: Recruiter with nine years across in-house HR and tech recruiting, with a psychology degree from LMU München. Hires software and hardware engineers for an automotive software company, and built an active sourcing programme that now produces 45% of hires.

experience.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
bullets: Recruit embedded software, safety and test engineers for a 1,200-person company, closing around 50 roles a year.
Built an active sourcing programme on LinkedIn and XING that now provides 45% of all hires, up from 15%.
Introduced structured interviews and anonymised CV screening checked for compliance with the AGG.
Coordinate relocation and EU Blue Card applications with the immigration service for hires from 14 countries.

experience.title: Tech Recruiter
bullets: Hired developers, designers and product managers for a growing e-commerce agency, about 35 hires a year.
Shortened time to offer from 41 to 27 days by moving technical tests earlier in the process.
Ran the company's presence at three careers fairs and two university hackathons.

experience.title: HR Officer, Recruiting (Personalreferentin)
bullets: Managed recruiting for production and lab roles, plus apprenticeships (Ausbildung) and dual-study places.
Coordinated the works council's participation in hiring decisions under the Works Constitution Act.
Replaced email-based applications with an applicant tracking system, cutting admin time per vacancy.

achievements.title: Active sourcing 15% to 45% of hires
achievements.detail: Programme built at Isarwerk Automotive Software.

achievements.title: Time to offer down to 27 days
achievements.detail: Earlier technical tests at Glockenbach Digital.
